description: Downloads the workout's FIT file, parsed. Default: compact summary (sport, distance, avg HR, training effect, laps as a COUNT, records_sample). full=true returns every record and lap (~550 KB for 35 laps, usually spills to a file); for laps use get_workout_laps. An unknown workoutKey fails with 403 here.

full.description: true: all parsed records. Default false.

name: get_workout_fit
title: Get workout FIT data
